expected_lifecycle: An explicit saved-scenario Load starts a new decision with the previous selected proposal and approval cleared. Previously reviewed alternatives should no longer be selectable until a new native Review alternatives request completes.
component_contract_preserved: The low-level alternatives binding intentionally accepts a new object with identical state, policy and now values. This control does not require changing that value-based contract.
static_observations: optionsSnapshotKey canonicalizes state, policy and now only.
clearPending does not assign optionsReview or optionsStatus.
render retires optionsReview only when optionsAreCurrent reports a changed value snapshot.
AdvisoryReviewPanel redraws when currentHash changes; clearing the selected proposal re-enables its row if the prior review remains current.
scope_limit: This is a fresh-decision lifecycle question. A value-identical alternative may remain mathematically valid; old approval reuse or an unsafe native separation result is not claimed.
first_group: Actual native alternatives, select and approve, choose the identical real saved scenario, explicit Load, record any old action and proposal revival; passing successor must allow a new native review and selection that requires new approval.
second_group: Change only the saved world's version before explicit Load, verifying that the existing value-snapshot invalidation remains functional.
